sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
Human approval is not simply adding a confirmation message before executing a tool.

In a production application, an approval is a governed authorization event associated with a specific proposed action.

steps.label: Goal
steps.narration: The agent receives a user goal and must decide what information or tools are required.

steps.label: Reason
steps.narration: The model plans the next action instead of answering blindly.

steps.label: Act / tool
steps.narration: The agent calls an authorized tool or function with structured arguments. Human approval is not simply adding a confirmation message before executing a tool.

steps.label: Observe
steps.narration: Usage, cost, latency, and traces are recorded for FinOps and incident response.

steps.label: Decide
steps.narration: The loop continues, escalates to a human, or finishes with a grounded answer.

sections.title: 18.2 Approval data model
sections.body:
```json
{
  "approval_id": "approval_101",
  "tenant_id": "tenant_01",
  "requested_by": "user_10",
  "operation": "create_purchase_order",
  "parameters": {
    "supplier_id": "SUP-101",
    "amount_minor_units": 50000000,
    "currency": "INR"
  },
  "action_digest": "hash-of-approved-action",
  "policy_version": "v4",
  "status": "pending",
  "required_role": "finance_approver",
  "expires_at": "2026-11-25T12:00:00Z"
}
```

This example represents ₹5 lakh as 50 million paise.

Approval must be bound to the exact action, amount, destination, identity, policy version and expiry.

steps.label: Input
steps.narration: Untrusted input enters the system and must be classified before use.

steps.label: Policy check
steps.narration: Security and tenancy policies decide what is allowed. Approval must be bound to the exact action, amount, destination, identity, policy version and expiry.

steps.label: Model
steps.narration: The model runs inside a trust boundary with constrained tools and prompts.

steps.label: Output filter
steps.narration: Outputs are scanned for leakage, jailbreaks, and policy violations.

steps.label: Audit
steps.narration: Every sensitive decision is logged for investigation and compliance.

sections.title: 18.3 Time-of-check to time-of-use — TOCTOU
sections.body:
Suppose a manager approves a ₹5 lakh purchase at 10:00 AM.

At 10:05 AM, another transaction consumes the remaining departmental budget.

At 10:10 AM, the agent resumes.

If it executes solely because a previous approval exists, it may violate the current budget constraint.

Therefore, revalidate permissions, approval validity and business state immediately before execution. Financial invariants should be enforced transactionally by the authoritative service.
